   213→                generation_params["resolution"] = DEFAULT_IMAGE_RESOLUTION
   214→
   215→        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as e:
   216→            # If download fails, clean up and raise error
   217→            if local_image_path:
   218→                import os
   219→                try:
   220→                    os.unlink(local_image_path)
   221→                except OSError as e_cleanup:
   222→                    headless_logger.debug(f"Failed to clean up temp image file after download error: {e_cleanup}", task_id=task_id)
   223→            raise ValueError(f"Task {task_id}: Failed to download image for img2img: {e}") from e
   224→
   225→        # CRITICAL: Pass local file path (not URL) to WGP
   226→        generation_params["image_start"] = local_image_path
   227→
   228→        # Set img2img parameters
   229→        generation_params.setdefault("video_prompt_type", "")  # Image input handled via image_start
   230→        generation_params.setdefault("video_length", 1)  # Single image output
   231→        generation_params.setdefault("guidance_scale", 0)  # Z-Image uses guidance_scale=0
   232→        generation_params.setdefault("num_inference_steps", int(db_task_params.get("num_inference_steps", 12)))
   233→
   234→        # CRITICAL: Add denoising_strength to generation_params so it gets passed through
   235→        actual_strength = db_task_params.get("denoising_strength") or db_task_params.get("denoise_strength") or db_task_params.get("strength", 0.7)
   236→        generation_params["denoising_strength"] = actual_strength
   237→
   238→        headless_logger.info(
   239→            f"[Z_IMAGE_I2I] Setup complete - local_image={local_image_path}, resolution={generation_params['resolution']}, "
   240→            f"strength={actual_strength}, steps={generation_params['num_inference_steps']}",
   241→            task_id=task_id
   242→        )
   243→
   244→        # Override model to use Z-Image img2img
   245→        model = "z_image_img2img"
   246→
   247→    # Defaults
   248→    essential_defaults = {
   249→        "seed": -1,
   250→        "negative_prompt": "",
   251→    }
   252→    for param, default_value in essential_defaults.items():
   253→        if param not in generation_params:
   254→            generation_params[param] = default_value
   255→    
   256→    # Phase Config Override
   257→    if "phase_config" in db_task_params:
   258→        try:
   259→            steps_per_phase = db_task_params["phase_config"].get("steps_per_phase", [2, 2, 2])
   260→            phase_config_steps = sum(steps_per_phase)
   261→
   262→            parsed_phase_config = parse_phase_config(
   263→                phase_config=db_task_params["phase_config"],
   264→                num_inference_steps=phase_config_steps,
   265→                task_id=task_id,
   266→                model_name=model,
   267→                debug_mode=debug_mode
   268→            )
   269→
   270→            generation_params["num_inference_steps"] = phase_config_steps
   271→
   272→            for key in ["guidance_phases", "switch_threshold", "switch_threshold2",
   273→                       "guidance_scale", "guidance2_scale", "guidance3_scale",
   274→                       "flow_shift", "sample_solver", "model_switch_phase",
   275→                       "lora_names", "lora_multipliers", "additional_loras"]:
   276→                if key in parsed_phase_config and parsed_phase_config[key] is not None:
   277→                    generation_params[key] = parsed_phase_config[key]
   278→
   279→            if "lora_names" in parsed_phase_config:
   280→                generation_params["activated_loras"] = parsed_phase_config["lora_names"]
   281→            if "lora_multipliers" in parsed_phase_config:
   282→                generation_params["loras_multipliers"] = " ".join(str(m) for m in parsed_phase_config["lora_multipliers"])
   283→
   284→            if "_patch_config" in parsed_phase_config:
   285→                generation_params["_parsed_phase_config"] = parsed_phase_config
   286→                generation_params["_phase_config_model_name"] = model
   287→            
   288→            # Note: LoRA URL resolution is handled centrally in HeadlessTaskQueue._convert_to_wgp_task()
   289→            # URLs in activated_loras are detected by LoRAConfig.from_params() and downloaded there
   290→        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as e:
   291→            raise ValueError(f"Task {task_id}: Invalid phase_config: {e}") from e
   292→
   293→    priority = db_task_params.get("priority", 0)
   294→    if task_type.endswith("_orchestrator"):
   295→        priority = max(priority, 10)
   296→    
   297→    generation_task = GenerationTask(
   298→        id=task_id,
   299→        model=model,
   300→        prompt=prompt,
   301→        parameters=generation_params,
   302→        priority=priority
   303→    )
   304→    
   305→    return generation_task
   306→
   307→

   209→def load_case_definitions(manifest_path: Path = DEFAULT_MANIFEST_PATH) -> list[CaseDefinition]:
   210→    payload = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   211→    cases = [CaseDefinition.from_dict(entry) for entry in payload["cases"]]
   212→    seen: set[str] = set()
   213→    for case in cases:
   214→        if case.case_id in seen:
   215→            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate case_id in manifest: {case.case_id}")
   216→        seen.add(case.case_id)
   217→    return cases

   221→    global _DB_SNAPSHOTS_CACHE
   222→    if _DB_SNAPSHOTS_CACHE is None:
   223→        payload = json.loads(snapshot_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   224→        _DB_SNAPSHOTS_CACHE = payload["snapshots"]
   225→    return _DB_SNAPSHOTS_CACHE

   228→def filter_case_definitions(

   234→    families: set[str] | None = None,
   235→    include_non_default: bool = False,
   236→) -> list[CaseDefinition]:
   237→    selected: list[CaseDefinition] = []
   238→    for case in cases:
   239→        if not include_non_default and not case.default_enabled:
   240→            continue
   241→        if case_ids and case.case_id not in case_ids:
   242→            continue
   243→        if task_types and case.task_type not in task_types:
   244→            continue
   245→        if families and case.family not in families:
   246→            continue
   247→        if tags and not tags.intersection(case.tags):
   248→            continue
   249→        selected.append(case)
   250→    return selected

   253→def requirements_status(case: CaseDefinition) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
   254→    missing: list[str] = []
   255→    for requirement in case.requires:

   257→        if checker is None:

   259→            continue

   333→        task_types=set(args.task_type) or None,

   362→        print(f"[{result.status.upper():7}] {case.case_id} -> {result.actual_outcome}")
   363→        if args.stop_on_failure and result.status == "failed":

   365→

   369→        "results": [asdict(result) for result in results],

   371→    _write_json(run_dir / "summary.json", summary_payload)
   372→    (run_dir / "summary.md").write_text(
   373→        format_summary_markdown(results, started_at=started_at, run_dir=run_dir),
   374→        encoding="utf-8",
   375→    )
   376→

   378→    (run_dir / "failures.txt").write_text("\n".join(failed_ids) + ("\n" if failed_ids else ""), encoding="utf-8")
   379→    rerun_lines = [
   380→        "#!/usr/bin/env bash",
   381→        "set -euo pipefail",
   382→        f"cd {shlex.quote(str(REPO_ROOT))}",
   383→        "python scripts/run_worker_matrix.py \\",

   385→    if failed_ids:
   386→        for case_id in failed_ids[:-1]:
   387→            rerun_lines.append(f"  --case-id {shlex.quote(case_id)} \\")
   388→        rerun_lines.append(f"  --case-id {shlex.quote(failed_ids[-1])}")
   389→    else:
   390→        rerun_lines.append("  --list-cases")
   391→    rerun_path = run_dir / "rerun_failed.sh"
   392→    rerun_path.write_text("\n".join(rerun_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
   393→    rerun_path.chmod(0o755)

   398→def run_case(case: CaseDefinition, run_dir: Path) -> CaseResult:
   399→    ensure_repo_on_path()

   413→            actual_outcome="skipped",
   414→            duration_seconds=0.0,
   415→            error_message=f"Missing requirements: {', '.join(missing_requirements)}",
   416→            log_path=str(log_path),

   418→        )
   419→        _write_json(case_dir / "result.json", asdict(result))
   420→        return result

   422→    prepared = CASE_BUILDERS[case.builder](case, case_dir)
   423→    _write_json(case_dir / "prepared_input.json", {
   424→        "task_type": prepared.definition.task_type,
   425→        "project_id": prepared.project_id,
   426→        "params": _json_safe(prepared.params),
   427→        "notes": _json_safe(prepared.notes),
   428→    })
   429→
   430→    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
   431→    actual_outcome = "failure"
   432→    output_path: str | None = None
   433→    error_message: str | None = None
   434→    traceback_path: str | None = None
   435→
   436→    with log_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log_file:
   437→        tee_stdout = TeeWriter(sys.__stdout__, log_file)
   438→        tee_stderr = TeeWriter(sys.__stderr__, log_file)
   439→        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(tee_stdout), contextlib.redirect_stderr(tee_stderr):
   440→            started_marker = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
   441→            print(
   442→                f"[WORKER_MATRIX][CASE_START] case_id={case.case_id} "
   443→                f"task_type={case.task_type} started_at={started_marker}"
   444→            )
   445→            try:
   446→                with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
   447→                    for patcher in prepared.patchers:
   448→                        stack.enter_context(patcher)
   449→
   450→                    worker_mod = __import__("worker")
   451→                    from source.core.log import enable_debug_mode
   452→

   461→                        mask_active_frames=prepared.mask_active_frames,
   462→                    )
   463→                success, output_path, error_message = _normalize_worker_result(raw_result)
   464→                actual_outcome = "success" if success else "failure"
   465→                print(
   466→                    f"[WORKER_MATRIX][CASE_END] case_id={case.case_id} "
   467→                    f"outcome={actual_outcome} output_path={output_path or ''} "
   468→                    f"error={error_message or ''}"

   475→                print(

   480→    duration_seconds = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - started).total_seconds()
   481→    expectation_matched = actual_outcome == case.expected_outcome
   482→    status = "passed" if expectation_matched else "failed"
   483→
   484→    result = CaseResult(

   502→
   503→def _normalize_worker_result(raw_result: Any) -> tuple[bool, str | None, str | None]:
   504→    if hasattr(raw_result, "outcome"):
   505→        from source.core.params.task_result import TaskOutcome
   506→
   507→        outcome = raw_result.outcome
   508→        if outcome == TaskOutcome.FAILED:
   509→            return False, None, getattr(raw_result, "error_message", None) or getattr(raw_result, "output_path", None)
   510→        if outcome in (TaskOutcome.ORCHESTRATING, TaskOutcome.ORCHESTRATOR_COMPLETE):
   511→            return False, None, f"Unexpected orchestrator outcome: {outcome.value}"
   512→        return True, getattr(raw_result, "output_path", None), None
   513→
   514→    if isinstance(raw_result, tuple) and len(raw_result) == 2:
   515→        success, value = raw_result
   516→        return bool(success), value if success else None, None if success else value
   517→
   518→    raise TypeError(f"Unsupported worker result shape: {type(raw_result).__name__}")

   700→def _create_test_image(path: Path, text: str) -> Path:
   701→    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   702→    image = Image.new("RGB", (256, 256), color=(24, 64, 96))
   703→    pixels = image.load()
   704→    for x in range(32, 224):
   705→        for y in range(96, 160):
   706→            pixels[x, y] = (180, 80, 32)
   707→    image.save(path)
   708→    return path

   711→def _create_test_video(path: Path, *, width: int = 320, height: int = 180, frames: int = 6, fps: int = 16) -> Path:
   712→    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   713→    fourcc = cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*"mp4v")
   714→    writer = cv2.VideoWriter(str(path), fourcc, fps, (width, height))
   715→    for frame_idx in range(frames):
   716→        image = np.zeros((height, width, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
   717→        image[:, :, 0] = (frame_idx * 25) % 255
   718→        image[:, :, 1] = 80
   719→        image[:, :, 2] = 200 - (frame_idx * 10)
   720→        writer.write(image)
   721→    writer.release()
   722→    return path

   729→    return _create_test_video(output_dir / f"{task_id}.mp4")

   739→def _load_snapshot_params(
   740→    snapshot_name: str,
   741→    *,
   742→    fixture_paths: dict[str, Path] | None = None,
   743→    fixture_urls: dict[str, str] | None = None,
   744→) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
   745→    snapshot = copy.deepcopy(load_db_snapshots()[snapshot_name])
   746→    replacements: dict[str, str] = {}
   747→    for key, value in (fixture_paths or {}).items():
   748→        replacements[f"__FIXTURE_PATH__:{key}"] = str(value)
   749→    for key, value in (fixture_urls or {}).items():
   750→        replacements[f"__FIXTURE_URL__:{key}"] = value
   751→    params = _replace_snapshot_tokens(snapshot["params"], replacements)
   752→    return snapshot, params
   753→
   754→
   755→def _replace_snapshot_tokens(value: Any, replacements: dict[str, str]) -> Any:
   756→    if isinstance(value, str):
   757→        return replacements.get(value, value)
   758→    if isinstance(value, dict):
   759→        return {[REDACTED](item, replacements) for key, item in value.items()}
   760→    if isinstance(value, list):
   761→        return [_replace_snapshot_tokens(item, replacements) for item in value]
   762→    return value
   763→

   769→        "source_created_at": snapshot["source_created_at"],
   770→        "db_task_type": snapshot["task_type"],
   771→    }

   774→def _json_safe(value: Any) -> Any:
   775→    if isinstance(value, Path):
   776→        return str(value)
   777→    if isinstance(value, dict):
   778→        return {str(k): _json_safe(v) for k, v in value.items()}
   779→    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
   780→        return [_json_safe(item) for item in value]
   781→    if isinstance(value, np.integer):
   782→        return int(value)
   783→    if isinstance(value, np.floating):
   784→        return float(value)
   785→    if isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
   786→        return value.tolist()
   787→    if isinstance(value, bytes):
   788→        return value.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
   789→    return value

    89→    try:
    90→        output_file = Path(output_path)
    91→
    92→        # Check if file exists
    93→        if not output_file.exists():
    94→            headless_logger.debug(f"Output file doesn't exist, skipping move: {output_path}", task_id=task_id)
    95→            return output_path
    96→
    97→        # Check if file is in base directory (not already in a subdirectory)
    98→        # If the parent directory is main_output_dir_base, it's in base directory
    99→        if output_file.parent.resolve() != main_output_dir_base.resolve():
   100→            headless_logger.debug(f"Output already in subdirectory, skipping move: {output_path}", task_id=task_id)
   101→            return output_path
   102→
   103→        # Generate new path in task-type subdirectory
   104→        filename = output_file.name
   105→        new_path, _ = prepare_output_path(
   106→            task_id=task_id,
   107→            filename=filename,
   108→            main_output_dir_base=main_output_dir_base,
   109→            task_type=task_type
   110→        )
   111→
   112→        # Move the file
   113→        headless_logger.info(
   114→            f"Moving WGP output to task-type directory: {output_file} → {new_path} (task_type={task_type})",
   115→            task_id=task_id
   116→        )
   117→
   118→        # Ensure destination directory exists
   119→        new_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   120→
   121→        # Move the file
   122→        shutil.move(str(output_file), str(new_path))
   123→
   124→        headless_logger.success(f"Moved WGP output to {new_path}", task_id=task_id)
   125→        return str(new_path)
   126→
   127→    except (OSError, shutil.Error, ValueError) as e:
   128→        headless_logger.error(f"Failed to move WGP output to task-type directory: {e}", task_id=task_id, exc_info=True)
   129→        # Return original path if move fails
   130→        return output_path

   132→def process_single_task(task_params_dict, main_output_dir_base: Path, task_type: str, project_id_for_task: str | None, image_download_dir: Path | str | None = None, colour_match_videos: bool = False, mask_active_frames: bool = True, task_queue: HeadlessTaskQueue = None):
   133→    from source.core.params.task_result import TaskResult, TaskOutcome
   134→
   135→    task_id = task_params_dict.get("task_id", "unknown_task_" + str(time.time()))
   136→    headless_logger.essential(f"Processing {task_type} task", task_id=task_id)
   137→
   138→    context = {
   139→        "task_params_dict": task_params_dict,
   140→        "main_output_dir_base": main_output_dir_base,
   141→        "task_id": task_id,
   142→        "project_id": project_id_for_task,
   143→        "task_queue": task_queue,
   144→        "colour_match_videos": colour_match_videos,
   145→        "mask_active_frames": mask_active_frames,
   146→        "debug_mode": debug_mode,
   147→        "wan2gp_path": wan2gp_path,
   148→    }
   149→
   150→    result = TaskRegistry.dispatch(task_type, context)
   151→    generation_success, output_location_to_db = result  # backward-compat unpacking
   152→
   153→    # Chaining Logic
   154→    if generation_success:
   155→        chaining_result_path_override = None
   156→
   157→        if task_params_dict.get("travel_chain_details"):
   158→            chain_success, chain_message, final_path_from_chaining = handle_travel_chaining_after_wgp(
   159→                wgp_task_params=task_params_dict,
   160→                actual_wgp_output_video_path=output_location_to_db,
   161→                image_download_dir=image_download_dir,
   162→                main_output_dir_base=main_output_dir_base,
   163→            )
   164→            if chain_success:
   165→                chaining_result_path_override = final_path_from_chaining
   166→            else:
   167→                headless_logger.error(f"Travel chaining failed: {chain_message}", task_id=task_id)
   168→
   169→        if chaining_result_path_override:
   170→            output_location_to_db = chaining_result_path_override
   171→
   172→        # Move WGP outputs to task-type subdirectories
   173→        # This post-processes WGP-generated files to organize them by task_type
   174→        if output_location_to_db:
   175→            output_location_to_db = move_wgp_output_to_task_type_dir(
   176→                output_path=output_location_to_db,
   177→                task_type=task_type,
   178→                task_id=task_id,
   179→                main_output_dir_base=main_output_dir_base
   180→            )
   181→
   182→    # Ensure orchestrator tasks use their DB row ID
   183→    if task_type in {"travel_orchestrator"}:
   184→        task_params_dict["task_id"] = task_id
   185→
   186→    headless_logger.essential(f"Finished task (Success: {generation_success})", task_id=task_id)
   187→
   188→    # Return structured TaskResult when the dispatch returned one, preserving
   189→    # thumbnail_url and outcome through the post-processing pipeline.
   190→    if isinstance(result, TaskResult):
   191→        if result.outcome == TaskOutcome.FAILED:
   192→            return result
   193→        # Rebuild with potentially-modified output_location_to_db
   194→        return TaskResult(
   195→            outcome=result.outcome,
   196→            output_path=output_location_to_db,
   197→            thumbnail_url=result.thumbnail_url,
   198→            metadata=result.metadata,
   199→        )
   200→    return generation_success, output_location_to_db
   201→

   205→    parser.add_argument("--main-output-dir", type=str, default="./outputs")

    57→# ─── Coordination dataclasses for handle_travel_segment_via_queue ────────────
    58→
    59→@dataclass
    60→class SegmentContext:
    61→    """Mode, orchestrator details, and segment identity."""
    62→    mode: str  # "orchestrator" or "standalone"
    63→    orchestrator_details: dict
    64→    individual_params: dict
    65→    segment_idx: int
    66→    segment_params: dict  # alias for the top-level task_params_dict
    67→    orchestrator_task_id_ref: Optional[str] = None
    68→    orchestrator_run_id: Optional[str] = None
    69→
    70→@dataclass
    71→class GenerationInputs:
    72→    """Model, prompt, resolution, frames, and flags."""
    73→    model_name: str
    74→    prompt_for_wgp: str
    75→    negative_prompt_for_wgp: str
    76→    parsed_res_wh: Tuple[int, int]
    77→    total_frames_for_segment: int
    78→    current_run_base_output_dir: Path
    79→    segment_processing_dir: Path
    80→    debug_enabled: bool
    81→    travel_mode: str
    82→
    83→@dataclass
    84→class ImageRefs:
    85→    """Image reference paths for the segment."""
    86→    start_ref_path: Optional[str] = None
    87→    end_ref_path: Optional[str] = None
    88→    svi_predecessor_video_for_source: Optional[str] = None
    89→    use_svi: bool = False
    90→    is_continuing: bool = False
    91→
    92→@dataclass
    93→class StructureOutputs:
    94→    """Results from structure guidance processing."""
    95→    guide_video_path: Optional[str] = None
    96→    mask_video_path_for_wgp: Optional[Path] = None
    97→    video_prompt_type_str: Optional[str] = None
    98→    structure_config: Optional[StructureGuidanceConfig] = None
    99→
   100→
   101→_MISSING = object()
   102→
   103→def _get_param(key, *sources, default=_MISSING, prefer_truthy: bool = False):
   104→    """
   105→    Get a parameter from multiple sources with precedence (first source wins).
   106→
   107→    By default, only skips None values.
   108→    If prefer_truthy=True, also skips falsy non-bool values (e.g. "", {}, [], 0),
   109→    matching historical `a or b` fallback semantics while still preserving explicit booleans.
   110→    """
   111→    for source in sources:
   112→        if not source or key not in source:
   113→            continue
   114→
   115→        value = source[key]
   116→        if value is None:
   117→            continue
   118→
   119→        if prefer_truthy and not isinstance(value, bool) and not value:
   120→            continue
   121→
   122→        return value
   123→
   124→    return None if default is _MISSING else default
   125→
   126→def _resolve_segment_context(task_params_dict: dict, is_standalone: bool, task_id: str) -> SegmentContext:
   127→    """Resolve mode, orchestrator_details, individual_params, and segment identity.
   128→
   129→    Handles orchestrator vs standalone mode, fetching orchestrator_details from the DB
   130→    if not provided inline.
   131→
   132→    Raises ValueError if required fields are missing.
   133→    """
   134→    segment_params = task_params_dict
   135→    orchestrator_task_id_ref = segment_params.get("orchestrator_task_id_ref")
   136→    orchestrator_run_id = segment_params.get("orchestrator_run_id")
   137→    segment_idx = segment_params.get("segment_index")
   138→
   139→    # Get orchestrator_details (canonical name) or full_orchestrator_payload (legacy alias)
   140→    orchestrator_details: dict = segment_params.get("orchestrator_details") or segment_params.get("full_orchestrator_payload")
   141→
   142→    if is_standalone:
   143→        # Standalone mode: use provided payload, default segment_idx to 0
   144→        if segment_idx is None:
   145→            segment_idx = 0
   146→        if not orchestrator_details:
   147→            raise ValueError(f"Individual travel segment {task_id} missing orchestrator_details")
   148→        headless_logger.debug(f"Running in standalone mode (individual_travel_segment)", task_id=task_id)
   149→    else:
   150→        # Orchestrator mode: require segment_index and either inline orchestrator_details or ability to fetch
   151→        if segment_idx is None:
   152→            raise ValueError(f"Travel segment {task_id} missing segment_index")
   153→
   154→        # If orchestrator_details not inline, try to fetch from parent task
   155→        if not orchestrator_details:
   156→            if not orchestrator_task_id_ref:
   157→                raise ValueError(f"Travel segment {task_id} missing orchestrator_details and orchestrator_task_id_ref")
   158→            orchestrator_task_raw_params_json = db_ops.get_task_params(orchestrator_task_id_ref)
   159→            if orchestrator_task_raw_params_json:
   160→                fetched_params = json.loads(orchestrator_task_raw_params_json) if isinstance(orchestrator_task_raw_params_json, str) else orchestrator_task_raw_params_json
   161→                orchestrator_details = fetched_params.get("orchestrator_details")
   162→
   163→        if not orchestrator_details:
   164→            raise ValueError(f"Travel segment {task_id}: Could not retrieve orchestrator_details")
   165→
   166→    # individual_segment_params has highest priority for segment-specific overrides
   167→    individual_params: IndividualSegmentParams = segment_params.get("individual_segment_params", {})
   168→
   169→    return SegmentContext(
   170→        mode="standalone" if is_standalone else "orchestrator",
   171→        orchestrator_details=orchestrator_details,
   172→        individual_params=individual_params,
   173→        segment_idx=segment_idx,
   174→        segment_params=segment_params,
   175→        orchestrator_task_id_ref=orchestrator_task_id_ref,
   176→        orchestrator_run_id=orchestrator_run_id,
   177→    )
   178→
   179→
   180→def _resolve_generation_inputs(ctx: SegmentContext, task_id: str, main_output_dir_base: Path) -> GenerationInputs:
   181→    """Resolve model, prompt, resolution, frame count, output directory, and flags.
   182→
   183→    Returns a GenerationInputs dataclass with all resolved values.
   184→    Raises ValueError if resolution format is invalid.
   185→    """
   186→    segment_params = ctx.segment_params
   187→    orchestrator_details = ctx.orchestrator_details
   188→    individual_params = ctx.individual_params
   189→    segment_idx = ctx.segment_idx
   190→
   191→    # Model name: segment > orchestrator (required)
   192→    model_name = segment_params.get("model_name") or orchestrator_details.get("model_name")
   193→    if not model_name:
   194→        raise ValueError(f"Travel segment {task_id}: model_name missing from both segment_params and orchestrator_details")
   195→
   196→    # Prompts: enhanced_prompt preferred > base_prompt fallback
   197→    # Frontend may provide both: enhanced_prompt (AI-enhanced) and base_prompt (user's original)
   198→    enhanced_prompt = _get_param("enhanced_prompt", individual_params, segment_params, default=None)
   199→    base_prompt = _get_param("base_prompt", individual_params, segment_params, default=" ")
   200→

988→def handle_travel_segment_via_queue(task_params_dict: dict, main_output_dir_base: Path, task_id: str, colour_match_videos: bool, mask_active_frames: bool, task_queue: HeadlessTaskQueue, is_standalone: bool = False):
   989→    """Handle travel segment tasks via direct queue integration to eliminate blocking waits.
   990→
   991→    Orchestrator mode (is_standalone=False) requires orchestrator_task_id_ref, orchestrator_run_id, segment_index.
   992→    Standalone mode (is_standalone=True) uses orchestrator_details provided directly in params.
   993→    Parameter precedence: individual_segment_params > segment_params > orchestrator_details.
   994→    """
   995→    headless_logger.debug(f"Starting travel segment queue processing (standalone={is_standalone})", task_id=task_id)
   996→    log_ram_usage("Segment via queue - start", task_id=task_id)
   997→
   998→    try:
   999→        from source.task_handlers.travel.chaining import handle_travel_chaining_after_wgp

  1001→        # 1. Resolve segment context (mode, orchestrator_details, individual_params, segment_idx)
  1002→        ctx = _resolve_segment_context(task_params_dict, is_standalone, task_id)
  1003→
  1004→        # 2. Resolve generation inputs (model, prompt, resolution, frames, output dir, flags)

  1012→

  1014→        generation_params = _build_generation_params(ctx, gen, image_refs, structure, task_id)
  1015→
  1016→        # 6. Apply SVI-specific configuration
  1017→        _apply_svi_config(generation_params, ctx, gen, image_refs, task_id)
  1018→        # 7. Apply UNI3C-specific configuration
  1019→        _apply_uni3c_config(generation_params, ctx, gen, structure, task_id)
  1020→
  1021→        # Log diagnostic summary before WGP submission
  1022→        task_logger.debug(f"[WGP_SUBMIT] Task {task_id}: ========== WGP GENERATION REQUEST ==========")
  1023→        task_logger.debug(f"[WGP_SUBMIT] Task {task_id}: video_length (target frames): {generation_params.get('video_length')}")
  1024→        is_valid_4n1 = (generation_params.get('video_length', 0) - 1) % 4 == 0

  1028→        task_logger.debug(f"[WGP_SUBMIT] Task {task_id}: model: {gen.model_name}")
  1029→        task_logger.debug(f"[WGP_SUBMIT] Task {task_id}: resolution: {generation_params.get('resolution')}")
  1030→        task_logger.debug(f"[WGP_SUBMIT] Task {task_id}: =============================================")
  1031→
  1032→        # IMPORTANT: Use the DB task_id as the queue task id.
  1033→        # This keeps logs, fatal error handling, and debug tooling consistent (no "travel_seg_" indirection).
  1034→        # We still include a hint in parameters so the queue can apply any task-type specific behavior.
  1035→        generation_params["_source_task_type"] = "travel_segment"

  1038→        generation_task = GenerationTask(

  1042→            parameters=generation_params
  1043→        )
  1044→
  1045→        _submitted_task_id = task_queue.submit_task(generation_task)
  1046→
  1047→        max_wait_time = 1800
  1048→        wait_interval = 2
  1049→        elapsed_time = 0
  1050→
  1051→        while elapsed_time < max_wait_time:
  1052→            status = task_queue.get_task_status(task_id)

  1054→
  1055→            if status.status == "completed":

   104→class TeeWriter(io.TextIOBase):
   105→    """Mirror writes to the console and a case-local file."""
   106→
   107→    def __init__(self, *streams: io.TextIOBase):
   108→        self._streams = streams
   109→
   110→    @property
   111→    def encoding(self) -> str:
   112→        for stream in self._streams:
   113→            enc = getattr(stream, "encoding", None)
   114→            if enc:
   115→                return enc
   116→        return "utf-8"
   117→
   118→    def write(self, data: str) -> int:
   119→        for stream in self._streams:
   120→            stream.write(data)
   121→            stream.flush()
   122→        return len(data)
   123→
   124→    def flush(self) -> None:
   125→        for stream in self._streams:
   126→            stream.flush()

   174→        output_path: str | None = None

   179→                task_type=self.task_type,
   180→            ))

   182→        if validation_errors:

   209→def load_case_definitions(manifest_path: Path = DEFAULT_MANIFEST_PATH) -> list[CaseDefinition]:
   210→    payload = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   211→    cases = [CaseDefinition.from_dict(entry) for entry in payload["cases"]]
   212→    seen: set[str] = set()
   213→    for case in cases:
   214→        if case.case_id in seen:
   215→            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate case_id in manifest: {case.case_id}")
   216→        seen.add(case.case_id)
   217→    return cases
   218→
   219→
   220→def load_db_snapshots(snapshot_path: Path = DEFAULT_DB_SNAPSHOTS_PATH) -> dict[str, Any]:
   221→    global _DB_SNAPSHOTS_CACHE
   222→    if _DB_SNAPSHOTS_CACHE is None:
   223→        payload = json.loads(snapshot_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   224→        _DB_SNAPSHOTS_CACHE = payload["snapshots"]
   225→    return _DB_SNAPSHOTS_CACHE

   228→def filter_case_definitions(
   229→    cases: list[CaseDefinition],
   230→    *,
   231→    case_ids: set[str] | None = None,
   232→    task_types: set[str] | None = None,
   233→    tags: set[str] | None = None,
   234→    families: set[str] | None = None,
   235→    include_non_default: bool = False,
   236→) -> list[CaseDefinition]:
   237→    selected: list[CaseDefinition] = []
   238→    for case in cases:
   239→        if not include_non_default and not case.default_enabled:
   240→            continue
   241→        if case_ids and case.case_id not in case_ids:
   242→            continue
   243→        if task_types and case.task_type not in task_types:
   244→            continue
   245→        if families and case.family not in families:
   246→            continue
   247→        if tags and not tags.intersection(case.tags):
   248→            continue
   249→        selected.append(case)
   250→    return selected

   253→def requirements_status(case: CaseDefinition) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
   254→    missing: list[str] = []
   255→    for requirement in case.requires:
   256→        checker = REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS.get(requirement)
   257→        if checker is None:
   258→            missing.append(f"unknown requirement:{requirement}")
   259→            continue
   260→        if not checker():
   261→            missing.append(requirement)
   262→    return (len(missing) == 0, missing)

   398→def run_case(case: CaseDefinition, run_dir: Path) -> CaseResult:
   399→    ensure_repo_on_path()
   400→    case_dir = run_dir / case.case_id
   401→    case_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   402→    log_path = case_dir / "worker.log"
   403→    _write_json(case_dir / "case_definition.json", asdict(case))

   405→    requirements_ok, missing_requirements = requirements_status(case)

   408→            case_id=case.case_id,
   409→            task_type=case.task_type,
   410→            family=case.family,
   411→            status="skipped",
   412→            expected_outcome=case.expected_outcome,
   413→            actual_outcome="skipped",
   414→            duration_seconds=0.0,
   415→            error_message=f"Missing requirements: {', '.join(missing_requirements)}",
   416→            log_path=str(log_path),
   417→            case_dir=str(case_dir),
   418→        )
   419→        _write_json(case_dir / "result.json", asdict(result))
   420→        return result
   421→
   422→    prepared = CASE_BUILDERS[case.builder](case, case_dir)

   424→        "task_type": prepared.definition.task_type,
   425→        "project_id": prepared.project_id,
   426→        "params": _json_safe(prepared.params),
   427→        "notes": _json_safe(prepared.notes),
   428→    })
   429→
   430→    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
   431→    actual_outcome = "failure"
   432→    output_path: str | None = None
   433→    error_message: str | None = None
   434→    traceback_path: str | None = None
   435→
   436→    with log_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log_file:
   437→        tee_stdout = TeeWriter(sys.__stdout__, log_file)
   438→        tee_stderr = TeeWriter(sys.__stderr__, log_file)
   439→        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(tee_stdout), contextlib.redirect_stderr(tee_stderr):
   440→            started_marker = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
   441→            print(
   442→                f"[WORKER_MATRIX][CASE_START] case_id={case.case_id} "
   443→                f"task_type={case.task_type} started_at={started_marker}"
   444→            )
   445→            try:
   446→                with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
   447→                    for patcher in prepared.patchers:
   448→                        stack.enter_context(patcher)
   449→
   450→                    worker_mod = __import__("worker")

   452→
   453→                    enable_debug_mode()
   454→                    raw_result = worker_mod.process_single_task(
   455→                        task_params_dict=copy.deepcopy(prepared.params),

   457→                        task_type=prepared.definition.task_type,
   458→                        project_id_for_task=prepared.project_id,
   459→                        task_queue=prepared.task_queue,
   460→                        colour_match_videos=prepared.colour_match_videos,
   461→                        mask_active_frames=prepared.mask_active_frames,
   462→                    )
   463→                success, output_path, error_message = _normalize_worker_result(raw_result)
   464→                actual_outcome = "success" if success else "failure"
   465→                print(

   467→                    f"outcome={actual_outcome} output_path={output_path or ''} "
   468→                    f"error={error_message or ''}"
   469→                )
   470→            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
   471→                error_message = str(exc)

   503→def _normalize_worker_result(raw_result: Any) -> tuple[bool, str | None, str | None]:
   504→    if hasattr(raw_result, "outcome"):
   505→        from source.core.params.task_result import TaskOutcome
   506→
   507→        outcome = raw_result.outcome
   508→        if outcome == TaskOutcome.FAILED:
   509→            return False, None, getattr(raw_result, "error_message", None) or getattr(raw_result, "output_path", None)
   510→        if outcome in (TaskOutcome.ORCHESTRATING, TaskOutcome.ORCHESTRATOR_COMPLETE):
   511→            return False, None, f"Unexpected orchestrator outcome: {outcome.value}"
   512→        return True, getattr(raw_result, "output_path", None), None
   513→
   514→    if isinstance(raw_result, tuple) and len(raw_result) == 2:
   515→        success, value = raw_result
   516→        return bool(success), value if success else None, None if success else value
   517→
   518→    raise TypeError(f"Unsupported worker result shape: {type(raw_result).__name__}")

   700→def _create_test_image(path: Path, text: str) -> Path:
   701→    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   702→    image = Image.new("RGB", (256, 256), color=(24, 64, 96))
   703→    pixels = image.load()
   704→    for x in range(32, 224):

   706→            pixels[x, y] = (180, 80, 32)
   707→    image.save(path)
   708→    return path

   711→def _create_test_video(path: Path, *, width: int = 320, height: int = 180, frames: int = 6, fps: int = 16) -> Path:
   712→    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   713→    fourcc = cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*"mp4v")
   714→    writer = cv2.VideoWriter(str(path), fourcc, fps, (width, height))
   715→    for frame_idx in range(frames):
   716→        image = np.zeros((height, width, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
   717→        image[:, :, 0] = (frame_idx * 25) % 255
   718→        image[:, :, 1] = 80
   719→        image[:, :, 2] = 200 - (frame_idx * 10)
   720→        writer.write(image)
   721→    writer.release()
   722→    return path

   745→    snapshot = copy.deepcopy(load_db_snapshots()[snapshot_name])
   746→    replacements: dict[str, str] = {}
   747→    for key, value in (fixture_paths or {}).items():

   749→    for key, value in (fixture_urls or {}).items():

   751→    params = _replace_snapshot_tokens(snapshot["params"], replacements)
   752→    return snapshot, params

   755→def _replace_snapshot_tokens(value: Any, replacements: dict[str, str]) -> Any:
   756→    if isinstance(value, str):

   758→    if isinstance(value, dict):
   759→        return {[REDACTED](item, replacements) for key, item in value.items()}
   760→    if isinstance(value, list):
   761→        return [_replace_snapshot_tokens(item, replacements) for item in value]
   762→    return value

   774→def _json_safe(value: Any) -> Any:
   775→    if isinstance(value, Path):
   776→        return str(value)
   777→    if isinstance(value, dict):
   778→        return {str(k): _json_safe(v) for k, v in value.items()}
   779→    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
   780→        return [_json_safe(item) for item in value]
   781→    if isinstance(value, np.integer):
   782→        return int(value)
   783→    if isinstance(value, np.floating):
   784→        return float(value)
   785→    if isinstance(value, np.ndarray):

   787→    if isinstance(value, bytes):

1→# Worker Matrix Runner
     2→
     3→`scripts/run_worker_matrix.py` runs a curated set of worker-facing smoke cases and writes artifacts for each case under `artifacts/worker-matrix/`.
     4→
     5→## What It Covers
     6→
     7→- Real `worker.py -> process_single_task()` execution with real task routing and parameter conversion
     8→- For direct-queue generation cases, a fake immediate queue captures the submitted generation task after real payload conversion, then returns a synthetic output. This catches routing and parameter-shape regressions without requiring GPU execution.
     9→- For local-only cases (e.g. `extract_frame`, `create_visualization`), the handler runs end-to-end.
    10→- Per-case logs, inputs, outputs, and summaries
    11→
    12→## Basic Usage
    13→
    14→Run the default suite:
    15→
    16→```bash
    17→python scripts/run_worker_matrix.py
    18→```
    19→
    20→List available cases:
    21→
    22→```bash
    23→python scripts/run_worker_matrix.py --list-cases
    24→```
    25→
    26→Run only selected cases:
    27→
    28→```bash
    29→python scripts/run_worker_matrix.py --case-id qwen_image_style_db_task --case-id z_image_turbo_db_task
    30→```
    31→
    32→Filter by tag, task type, or family:
    33→
    34→```bash
    35→python scripts/run_worker_matrix.py --tag qwen
    36→python scripts/run_worker_matrix.py --task-type extract_frame
    37→python scripts/run_worker_matrix.py --family direct_queue
    38→```
    39→
    40→Rerun only failed cases from a previous summary:
    41→
    42→```bash
    43→python scripts/run_worker_matrix.py --failed-from artifacts/worker-matrix/<run>/summary.json
    44→```
    45→
    46→Stop on first failure:
    47→
    48→```bash
    49→python scripts/run_worker_matrix.py --stop-on-failure
    50→```
    51→
    52→Include non-default cases:
    53→
    54→```bash
    55→python scripts/run_worker_matrix.py --all-cases
    56→```
    57→
    58→Override manifest or output directory:
    59→
    60→```bash
    61→python scripts/run_worker_matrix.py --manifest path/to/custom.json --output-dir path/to/output
    62→```
    63→
    64→## Case Definitions and DB Snapshots
    65→
    66→Cases are defined in `scripts/worker_matrix_cases.json`. Each case references a builder function in the script, a task type, a family, tags, and an `expected_outcome` (`"success"` or `"failure"`). Cases can also declare `requires` (e.g. `ffmpeg`) and are auto-skipped when requirements are missing.
    67→
    68→Several cases load frozen DB task payloads from `scripts/worker_matrix_db_snapshots.json`. Snapshots contain real parameter shapes captured from production tasks, with `__FIXTURE_PATH__` and `__FIXTURE_URL__` placeholder tokens that get substituted with local test fixtures at runtime.
    69→
    70→## Artifacts
    71→
    72→Each run creates a timestamped directory:
    73→
    74→```text
    75→artifacts/worker-matrix/<timestamp>/
    76→```
    77→
    78→Top-level files:
    79→
    80→- `selected_cases.json`
    81→- `summary.json`
    82→- `summary.md`
    83→- `failures.txt`
    84→- `rerun_failed.sh`
    85→
    86→Per-case files:
    87→
    88→- `case_definition.json`
    89→- `prepared_input.json`
    90→- `captured_generation_task.json` for fake-queue direct cases
    91→- `worker.log`
    92→- `result.json`
    93→- `traceback.txt` when a case crashes
    94→- generated local outputs
    95→
    96→## Current Locked Cases
    97→
    98→- `vace_cocktail_2_2_basic`
    99→- `individual_travel_segment_wan22_i2v_baseline_2_2_2`
   100→- `ltx2_22b_basic`
   101→- `z_image_turbo_db_task`
   102→- `z_image_turbo_i2i_db_task`
   103→- `qwen_image_style_db_task`
   104→- `qwen_image_edit_db_task`
   105→
   106→## Notes
   107→
   108→- The runner is intentionally serial. It is optimizing for readable failures, not throughput.
   109→- The locked suite is centered on DB-backed Wan 2.2, Qwen, and Z-Image tasks, plus an LTX 2.3 representative `ltx2_22B` case.
   110→- Every case writes a live `worker.log` plus explicit `[WORKER_MATRIX][CASE_START]`, `[CASE_END]`, and `[CASE_EXCEPTION]` markers so failures are easy to spot during and after the run.
   111→- A case passes when its `actual_outcome` matches its `expected_outcome`. This lets you lock in expected-failure cases as regression guards.
   112→
```

    97→        # Check if file is in base directory (not already in a subdirectory)
    98→        # If the parent directory is main_output_dir_base, it's in base directory
    99→        if output_file.parent.resolve() != main_output_dir_base.resolve():
   100→            headless_logger.debug(f"Output already in subdirectory, skipping move: {output_path}", task_id=task_id)
   101→            return output_path
   102→
   103→        # Generate new path in task-type subdirectory
   104→        filename = output_file.name
   105→        new_path, _ = prepare_output_path(
   106→            task_id=task_id,
   107→            filename=filename,
   108→            main_output_dir_base=main_output_dir_base,
   109→            task_type=task_type
   110→        )
   111→
   112→        # Move the file
   113→        headless_logger.info(
   114→            f"Moving WGP output to task-type directory: {output_file} → {new_path} (task_type={task_type})",
   115→            task_id=task_id
   116→        )
   117→
   118→        # Ensure destination directory exists
   119→        new_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   120→
   121→        # Move the file
   122→        shutil.move(str(output_file), str(new_path))
   123→
   124→        headless_logger.success(f"Moved WGP output to {new_path}", task_id=task_id)
   125→        return str(new_path)
   126→
   127→    except (OSError, shutil.Error, ValueError) as e:
   128→        headless_logger.error(f"Failed to move WGP output to task-type directory: {e}", task_id=task_id, exc_info=True)
   129→        # Return original path if move fails
   130→        return output_path
   131→
   132→def process_single_task(task_params_dict, main_output_dir_base: Path, task_type: str, project_id_for_task: str | None, image_download_dir: Path | str | None = None, colour_match_videos: bool = False, mask_active_frames: bool = True, task_queue: HeadlessTaskQueue = None):
   133→    from source.core.params.task_result import TaskResult, TaskOutcome
   134→
   135→    task_id = task_params_dict.get("task_id", "unknown_task_" + str(time.time()))
   136→    headless_logger.essential(f"Processing {task_type} task", task_id=task_id)
   137→
   138→    context = {
   139→        "task_params_dict": task_params_dict,
   140→        "main_output_dir_base": main_output_dir_base,
   141→        "task_id": task_id,
   142→        "project_id": project_id_for_task,
   143→        "task_queue": task_queue,
   144→        "colour_match_videos": colour_match_videos,
   145→        "mask_active_frames": mask_active_frames,
   146→        "debug_mode": debug_mode,
   147→        "wan2gp_path": wan2gp_path,
   148→    }
   149→
   150→    result = TaskRegistry.dispatch(task_type, context)
   151→    generation_success, output_location_to_db = result  # backward-compat unpacking
   152→
   153→    # Chaining Logic
   154→    if generation_success:
   155→        chaining_result_path_override = None
   156→
   157→        if task_params_dict.get("travel_chain_details"):
   158→            chain_success, chain_message, final_path_from_chaining = handle_travel_chaining_after_wgp(
   159→                wgp_task_params=task_params_dict,
   160→                actual_wgp_output_video_path=output_location_to_db,
   161→                image_download_dir=image_download_dir,
   162→                main_output_dir_base=main_output_dir_base,
   163→            )
   164→            if chain_success:
   165→                chaining_result_path_override = final_path_from_chaining
   166→            else:
   167→                headless_logger.error(f"Travel chaining failed: {chain_message}", task_id=task_id)
   168→
   169→        if chaining_result_path_override:
   170→            output_location_to_db = chaining_result_path_override
   171→
   172→        # Move WGP outputs to task-type subdirectories
   173→        # This post-processes WGP-generated files to organize them by task_type
   174→        if output_location_to_db:
   175→            output_location_to_db = move_wgp_output_to_task_type_dir(
   176→                output_path=output_location_to_db,
   177→                task_type=task_type,
   178→                task_id=task_id,
   179→                main_output_dir_base=main_output_dir_base
   180→            )
   181→
   182→    # Ensure orchestrator tasks use their DB row ID
   183→    if task_type in {"travel_orchestrator"}:
   184→        task_params_dict["task_id"] = task_id
   185→
   186→    headless_logger.essential(f"Finished task (Success: {generation_success})", task_id=task_id)
   187→
   188→    # Return structured TaskResult when the dispatch returned one, preserving
   189→    # thumbnail_url and outcome through the post-processing pipeline.
   190→    if isinstance(result, TaskResult):
   191→        if result.outcome == TaskOutcome.FAILED:
   192→            return result
   193→        # Rebuild with potentially-modified output_location_to_db
   194→        return TaskResult(
   195→            outcome=result.outcome,
   196→            output_path=output_location_to_db,
   197→            thumbnail_url=result.thumbnail_url,
   198→            metadata=result.metadata,
   199→        )
   200→    return generation_success, output_location_to_db
   201→
   202→
   203→def parse_args():
   204→    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser("WanGP Worker Server")
   205→    parser.add_argument("--main-output-dir", type=str, default="./outputs")
   206→    parser.add_argument("--poll-interval", type=int, default=10)
   207→    parser.add_argument("--debug", action="store_true")
   208→    parser.add_argument("--worker", type=str, default=None)
   209→    parser.add_argument("--save-logging", type=str, nargs='?', const='logs/worker.log', default=None)
   210→    parser.add_argument("--migrate-only", action="store_true")
   211→    parser.add_argument("--colour-match-videos", action="store_true")
   212→    parser.add_argument("--mask-active-frames", dest="mask_active_frames", action="store_true", default=True)
   213→    parser.add_argument("--no-mask-active-frames", dest="mask_active_frames", action="store_false")
   214→    parser.add_argument("--queue-workers", type=int, default=1)
   215→    parser.add_argument("--preload-model", type=str, default="")
   216→    parser.add_argument("--db-type", type=str, default="supabase")
   217→    parser.add_argument("--supabase-url", type=str, default="https://[REDACTED]")
   218→    parser.add_argument("--reigh-access-token", type=str, default=None, help="Access token for Reigh API (preferred)")
   219→    parser.add_argument("--supabase-access-token", type=str, default=None, help="Legacy alias for --reigh-access-token")
   220→    parser.add_argument("--supabase-anon-key", type=str, default=None, help="Supabase anon key (set via env SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)")
   221→    
   222→    # WGP Globals
   223→    parser.add_argument("--wgp-attention-mode", type=str, default=None)
   224→    parser.add_argument("--wgp-compile", type=str, default=None)
   225→    parser.add_argument("--wgp-profile", type=int, default=None)
   226→    parser.add_argument("--wgp-vae-config", type=int, default=None)
   227→    parser.add_argument("--wgp-boost", type=int, default=None)
   228→    parser.add_argument("--wgp-transformer-quantization", type=str, default=None)
   229→    parser.add_argument("--wgp-transformer-dtype-policy", type=str, default=None)
   230→    parser.add_argument("--wgp-text-encoder-quantization", type=str, default=None)
   231→    parser.add_argument("--wgp-vae-precision", type=str, default=None)
   232→    parser.add_argument("--wgp-mixed-precision", type=str, default=None)
   233→    parser.add_argument("--wgp-preload-policy", type=str, default=None)
   234→    parser.add_argument("--wgp-preload", type=int, default=None)
   235→
   236→    return parser.parse_args()
   237→
   238→def main():
   239→    load_dotenv()
   240→
   241→    cli_args = parse_args()
   242→
   243→    # Resolve access token: prefer --reigh-access-token, fall back to --supabase-access-token
   244→    [REDACTED] or cli_args.supabase_access_token
   245→    if not access_token:
   246→        print("Error: Worker authentication credential is required", file=sys.stderr)
   247→        sys.exit(1)

   265→        if not cli_args.save_logging:

   267→            timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
   268→            log_dir = "logs"

   273→    else:

   275→
   276→    if cli_args.save_logging:
   277→        set_log_file(cli_args.save_logging)
   278→
   279→    # Supabase Setup
   280→    try:
   281→        # Service key takes priority (RunPod workers), then fall back to anon key (local workers)
   282→        client_key = os.getenv("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") or cli_args.supabase_anon_key or os.getenv("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")
   283→        if not client_key: raise ValueError("No Supabase key found")

   293→
   294→        # Propagate to os.environ for code that can't import db_operations
   295→        # (fatal_error_handler during crashes, headless_wgp notify_model_switch)
   296→        os.environ["SUPABASE_URL"] = cli_args.supabase_url
   297→
   298→        # Validate config after initialization

   304→    except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError) as e:

   307→
   308→    if cli_args.migrate_only:

   310→

   313→

   321→        _global_log_buffer = LogBuffer(max_size=100, shared_queue=log_queue)
   322→        _log_interceptor_instance = CustomLogInterceptor(_global_log_buffer)
   323→        set_log_interceptor(_log_interceptor_instance)
   324→
   325→    # Apply WGP Overrides
   326→    wan_dir = str((Path(__file__).parent / "Wan2GP").resolve())
   327→    original_cwd = os.getcwd()
   328→    original_argv = sys.argv[:]
   329→    try:
   330→        os.chdir(wan_dir)
   331→        sys.path.insert(0, wan_dir)
   332→        sys.argv = ["worker.py"]
   333→        import wgp as wgp_mod
   334→        sys.argv = original_argv
   335→
   336→        if cli_args.wgp_attention_mode: wgp_mod.attention_mode = cli_args.wgp_attention_mode
   337→        if cli_args.wgp_compile: wgp_mod.compile = cli_args.wgp_compile
   338→        if cli_args.wgp_profile: 
   339→            wgp_mod.force_profile_no = cli_args.wgp_profile
   340→            wgp_mod.default_profile = cli_args.wgp_profile
   341→        if cli_args.wgp_vae_config: wgp_mod.vae_config = cli_args.wgp_vae_config
   342→        if cli_args.wgp_boost: wgp_mod.boost = cli_args.wgp_boost
   343→        if cli_args.wgp_transformer_quantization: wgp_mod.transformer_quantization = cli_args.wgp_transformer_quantization
   344→        if cli_args.wgp_transformer_dtype_policy: wgp_mod.transformer_dtype_policy = cli_args.wgp_transformer_dtype_policy
   345→        if cli_args.wgp_text_encoder_quantization: wgp_mod.text_encoder_quantization = cli_args.wgp_text_encoder_quantization
   346→        if cli_args.wgp_vae_precision: wgp_mod.server_config["vae_precision"] = cli_args.wgp_vae_precision
   347→        if cli_args.wgp_mixed_precision: wgp_mod.server_config["mixed_precision"] = cli_args.wgp_mixed_precision
   348→        if cli_args.wgp_preload_policy: wgp_mod.server_config["preload_model_policy"] = [x.strip() for x in cli_args.wgp_preload_policy.split(',')]
   349→        if cli_args.wgp_preload: wgp_mod.server_config["preload_in_VRAM"] = cli_args.wgp_preload
   350→        if "transformer_types" not in wgp_mod.server_config: wgp_mod.server_config["transformer_types"] = []
   351→
   352→    except (ImportError, RuntimeError, AttributeError, KeyError) as e:
   353→        headless_logger.critical(f"WGP import failed: {e}")
   354→        sys.exit(1)
   355→    finally:
   356→        os.chdir(original_cwd)
   357→
   358→    # Clean up legacy collision-prone LoRA files
   359→    cleanup_legacy_lora_collisions()
   360→
   361→    # Initialize Task Queue
   362→    try:
   363→        task_queue = HeadlessTaskQueue(
   364→            wan_dir=wan_dir,
   365→            max_workers=cli_args.queue_workers,
   366→            debug_mode=debug_mode,
   367→            main_output_dir=str(main_output_dir)
   368→        )
   369→        preload_model = cli_args.preload_model if cli_args.preload_model else None
   370→        task_queue.start(preload_model=preload_model)
   371→    except (RuntimeError, ValueError, OSError) as e:
   372→        headless_logger.critical(f"Queue init failed: {e}")
   373→        sys.exit(1)
   374→
   375→    headless_logger.essential(f"Worker {cli_args.worker or 'anonymous'} started. Polling every {cli_args.poll_interval}s.")
   376→
   377→    try:
   378→        while True:
   379→            task_info = db_ops.get_oldest_queued_task_supabase(worker_id=cli_args.worker)
   380→
   381→            if not task_info:
   382→                time.sleep(cli_args.poll_interval)
   383→                continue
   384→
   385→            current_task_params = task_info["params"]
   386→            current_task_type = task_info["task_type"]
   387→            current_project_id = task_info.get("project_id")
   388→            current_task_id = task_info["task_id"]
   389→
   390→            if current_project_id is None and current_task_type in {"travel_orchestrator", "edit_video_orchestrator"}:
   391→                db_ops.update_task_status_supabase(current_task_id, db_ops.STATUS_FAILED, "Orchestrator missing project_id")
   392→                continue
   393→
   394→            # Ensure params["task_id"] is the DB UUID (not the human-readable params.task_id)
   395→            # process_single_task reads task_id from params, so this must be set for ALL task types
   396→            current_task_params["task_id"] = current_task_id
   397→            if "orchestrator_details" in current_task_params:
   398→                current_task_params["orchestrator_details"]["orchestrator_task_id"] = current_task_id
   399→
   400→            # Set current task context for log interceptor so all logs are associated with this task
   401→            if _log_interceptor_instance:
   402→                _log_interceptor_instance.set_current_task(current_task_id)
   403→
   404→            from source.core.params.task_result import TaskResult, TaskOutcome
   405→            raw_result = process_single_task(
   406→                current_task_params, main_output_dir, current_task_type, current_project_id,
   407→                image_download_dir=current_task_params.get("segment_image_download_dir"),
   408→                colour_match_videos=cli_args.colour_match_videos,
   409→                mask_active_frames=cli_args.mask_active_frames,
   410→                task_queue=task_queue
   411→            )
   412→
   413→            # Unpack: raw_result is either a TaskResult or a legacy (bool, str) tuple
   414→            if isinstance(raw_result, TaskResult):
   415→                result = raw_result
   416→                task_succeeded, output_location = raw_result  # __iter__ unpacking
   417→            else:
   418→                task_succeeded, output_location = raw_result
   419→                result = None
   420→
   421→            if task_succeeded:
   422→                reset_fatal_error_counter()
   423→
   424→                orchestrator_types = {"travel_orchestrator", "join_clips_orchestrator", "edit_video_orchestrator"}
   425→
   426→                if current_task_type in orchestrator_types:
   427→                    if result and result.outcome == TaskOutcome.ORCHESTRATOR_COMPLETE:
   428→                        db_ops.update_task_status_supabase(
   429→                            current_task_id, db_ops.STATUS_COMPLETE,
   430→                            result.output_path, result.thumbnail_url)
   431→                    elif result and result.outcome == TaskOutcome.ORCHESTRATING:
   432→                        db_ops.update_task_status(current_task_id, db_ops.STATUS_IN_PROGRESS, result.output_path)
   433→                    elif isinstance(output_location, str) and output_location.startswith("[ORCHESTRATOR_COMPLETE]"):
   434→                        # Legacy string prefix parsing (backward compat during migration)
   435→                        actual_output = output_location.replace("[ORCHESTRATOR_COMPLETE]", "")
   436→                        thumbnail_url = None
   437→                        try:
   438→                            import json
   439→                            data = json.loads(actual_output)
   440→                            actual_output = data.get("output_location", actual_output)
   441→                            thumbnail_url = data.get("thumbnail_url")
   442→                        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, KeyError):
   443→                            pass
   444→                        db_ops.update_task_status_supabase(current_task_id, db_ops.STATUS_COMPLETE, actual_output, thumbnail_url)
   445→                    else:
   446→                        db_ops.update_task_status(current_task_id, db_ops.STATUS_IN_PROGRESS, output_location)
   447→                else:
   448→                    db_ops.update_task_status_supabase(current_task_id, db_ops.STATUS_COMPLETE, output_location)
   449→
   450→                    # Note: Orchestrator completion is handled by the complete-task Edge Function
   451→                    # based on checking if all child tasks are complete.
   452→
   453→                    cleanup_generated_files(output_location, current_task_id, debug_mode)
   454→            else:
   455→                # Task failed - check if this is a retryable error
   456→                error_message = (result.error_message if result else output_location) or "Unknown error"
   457→                is_retryable, error_category, max_attempts = is_retryable_error(error_message)
   458→                current_attempts = task_info.get("attempts", 0)
   459→                
   460→                if is_retryable and current_attempts < max_attempts:
   461→                    # Requeue for retry
   462→                    headless_logger.warning(
   463→                        f"Task {current_task_id} failed with retryable error ({error_category}), "
   464→                        f"requeuing for retry (attempt {current_attempts + 1}/{max_attempts})"
   465→                    )
   466→                    db_ops.requeue_task_for_retry(
   467→                        current_task_id, 
   468→                        error_message, 
   469→                        current_attempts, 
   470→                        error_category
   471→                    )
   472→                else:
   473→                    # Permanent failure - either not retryable or exhausted retries
   474→                    if is_retryable and current_attempts >= max_attempts:
   475→                        headless_logger.error(
   476→                            f"Task {current_task_id} exhausted {max_attempts} retry attempts for {error_category}"
   477→                        )
   478→                    db_ops.update_task_status_supabase(current_task_id, db_ops.STATUS_FAILED, output_location)
   479→            
   480→            # Clear task context from log interceptor
   481→            if _log_interceptor_instance:
   482→                _log_interceptor_instance.set_current_task(None)
   483→            
   484→            time.sleep(1)
   485→
   486→    except FatalWorkerError as e:
   487→        headless_logger.critical(f"Fatal Error: {e}")
   488→        sys.exit(1)
   489→    except KeyboardInterrupt:
   490→        headless_logger.essential("Shutting down...")
   491→    finally:
   492→        if cli_args.worker:
   493→            heartbeat_stop_event.set()
   494→        if task_queue:
   495→            task_queue.stop()
   496→
   497→if __name__ == "__main__":
   498→    main()

   172→
   173→            headless_logger.info(f"[Z_IMAGE_I2I] Downloaded image to: {local_image_path}", task_id=task_id)
   174→
   175→            # Handle resolution - auto-detect from image or use provided

   182→                    target_pixels = IMG2IMG_TARGET_MEGAPIXELS
   183→                    current_pixels = width * height

   185→                    if current_pixels > 0:

   206→                            task_id=task_id
   207→                        )

Now I have a complete picture. Here is the full analysis:

---

## Task Type: No separate type for distilled — same `ltx2` handles both

There is **one task type** `"ltx2"` for all LTX2 variants. The distinction between dev and distilled is made entirely by the `model` parameter, not the task type. `TASK_TYPE_TO_MODEL["ltx2"]` defaults to `"ltx2_19B"` — callers must pass `"model": "ltx2_22B_distilled"` (or `"ltx2_distilled"`) explicitly to get the distilled path.

---

## What `ltx2_pipeline` is and how it works

`ltx2_pipeline` is a **model definition field** (inside the `.json` `"model"` block), not a task param. It is read by `Wan2GP/models/ltx2/ltx2_handler.py` and `ltx2.py` from the loaded model definition at generation time. It is **not** passed through the task params whitelist at all — there is no entry for it in `param_whitelist` in `task_conversion.py`. Callers cannot and do not need to pass it; it is encoded in the model JSON itself.

The distilled model JSONs (`ltx2_distilled.json` and `ltx2_22B_distilled.json`) both set `"ltx2_pipeline": "distilled"` in their `"model"` block. The dev models omit this key, so they default to `"two_stage"` in the handler.

---

## What params pass through the whitelist — and what don't

**Present in the whitelist and relevant to LTX2 dev:**
- `guidance_scale` — yes (line 40)
- `audio_guidance_scale` — yes (line 41)
- `cfg_star_switch` — yes (line 53)

**NOT in the whitelist at all:**
- `perturbation_switch`
- `perturbation_layers`
- `perturbation_start_perc`
- `perturbation_end_perc`
- `alt_guidance_scale`
- `alt_scale`
- `apg_switch`

These appear in the dev model defaults (`ltx2_22B.json` and `ltx2_19B.json`) but the whitelist has no entries for them. If a caller puts them in `db_task_params`, they will be silently dropped and never reach `generation_params`.

---

## Distilled model test case

**Model string to use:** `"ltx2_22B_distilled"` (or `"ltx2_distilled"` for 19B variant)

**Default params from `ltx2_22B_distilled.json`:**
- `num_inference_steps`: 8
- `video_length`: 241
- `resolution`: `"1280x720"`
- No `guidance_scale` set (the distilled model doesn't use it)
- No `perturbation_*`, `alt_*`, or `apg_switch` — those are dev-only

**What `db_task_to_generation_task` will produce for a distilled task:**

Input `db_task_params`:
```python
{
    "prompt": "A cinematic scene.",
    "model": "ltx2_22B_distilled",
    "num_inference_steps": 8,
    "video_length": 241,
    "resolution": "1280x720",
}
```

Expected `GenerationTask` from conversion:
- `task.model` = `"ltx2_22B_distilled"`
- `task.prompt` = `"A cinematic scene."`
- `task.parameters["num_inference_steps"]` = `8`
- `task.parameters["video_length"]` = `241`
- `task.parameters["resolution"]` = `"1280x720"`
- `task.parameters["seed"]` = `-1` (essential default)
- `task.parameters["negative_prompt"]` = `""` (essential default)
- `task.parameters` does NOT contain `perturbation_switch`, `alt_guidance_scale`, `alt_scale`, `apg_switch`, or `ltx2_pipeline`

**Key assertion to make in the test:** If you pass `perturbation_switch`, `alt_guidance_scale`, or `alt_scale` in the input, they should be **absent** from `task.parameters` — confirming the whitelist drops them silently. This is also a bug worth flagging: callers of the dev model who expect those params to reach WGP will be disappointed.

**`task_type` to pass to `db_task_to_generation_task`:** `"ltx2"` — this is the only task type; there is no `"ltx2_distilled"` entry anywhere in `WGP_TASK_TYPES` or `TASK_TYPE_TO_MODEL`.

   177→            if image_size == "auto" or not db_task_params.get("resolution"):
   178→                with Image.open(local_image_path) as img:
   179→                    width, height = img.size
   180→
   181→                    # Scale to approximately 1 megapixel (1024x1024) while preserving aspect ratio
   182→                    target_pixels = IMG2IMG_TARGET_MEGAPIXELS
   183→                    current_pixels = width * height
   184→
   185→                    if current_pixels > 0:
   186→                        # Calculate scale factor to reach target pixels
   187→                        import math
   188→                        scale = math.sqrt(target_pixels / current_pixels)
   189→
   190→                        # Apply scale to both dimensions
   191→                        scaled_width = int(round(width * scale))
   192→                        scaled_height = int(round(height * scale))
   193→
   194→                        # Round to nearest multiple of 8 (Z-Image requirement)
   195→                        scaled_width = (scaled_width // 8) * 8
   196→                        scaled_height = (scaled_height // 8) * 8
   197→
   198→                        # Ensure minimum size
   199→                        scaled_width = max(8, scaled_width)
   200→                        scaled_height = max(8, scaled_height)
   201→
   202→                        generation_params["resolution"] = f"{scaled_width}x{scaled_height}"
   203→                        headless_logger.info(
   204→                            f"Scaled resolution: {width}x{height} ({current_pixels:,} px) → "
   205→                            f"{scaled_width}x{scaled_height} ({scaled_width*scaled_height:,} px, scale={scale:.3f})",
   206→                            task_id=task_id
   207→                        )
   208→                    else:
   209→                        generation_params["resolution"] = DEFAULT_IMAGE_RESOLUTION
   210→            elif "resolution" in db_task_params:
   211→                generation_params["resolution"] = db_task_params["resolution"]
   212→            else:
   213→                generation_params["resolution"] = DEFAULT_IMAGE_RESOLUTION
   214→
   215→        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as e:
   216→            # If download fails, clean up and raise error
   217→            if local_image_path:
   218→                import os
   219→                try:
   220→                    os.unlink(local_image_path)
   221→                except OSError as e_cleanup:
   222→                    headless_logger.debug(f"Failed to clean up temp image file after download error: {e_cleanup}", task_id=task_id)
   223→            raise ValueError(f"Task {task_id}: Failed to download image for img2img: {e}") from e
   224→
   225→        # CRITICAL: Pass local file path (not URL) to WGP
   226→        generation_params["image_start"] = local_image_path
   227→
   228→        # Set img2img parameters
   229→        generation_params.setdefault("video_prompt_type", "")  # Image input handled via image_start
   230→        generation_params.setdefault("video_length", 1)  # Single image output
   231→        generation_params.setdefault("guidance_scale", 0)  # Z-Image uses guidance_scale=0
   232→        generation_params.setdefault("num_inference_steps", int(db_task_params.get("num_inference_steps", 12)))
   233→
   234→        # CRITICAL: Add denoising_strength to generation_params so it gets passed through
   235→        actual_strength = db_task_params.get("denoising_strength") or db_task_params.get("denoise_strength") or db_task_params.get("strength", 0.7)
   236→        generation_params["denoising_strength"] = actual_strength
   237→
   238→        headless_logger.info(
   239→            f"[Z_IMAGE_I2I] Setup complete - local_image={local_image_path}, resolution={generation_params['resolution']}, "
   240→            f"strength={actual_strength}, steps={generation_params['num_inference_steps']}",
   241→            task_id=task_id
   242→        )
   243→
   244→        # Override model to use Z-Image img2img
   245→        model = "z_image_img2img"
   246→
   247→    # Defaults
   248→    essential_defaults = {
   249→        "seed": -1,
   250→        "negative_prompt": "",
   251→    }
   252→    for param, default_value in essential_defaults.items():
   253→        if param not in generation_params:
   254→            generation_params[param] = default_value
   255→    
   256→    # Phase Config Override
   257→    if "phase_config" in db_task_params:
   258→        try:
   259→            steps_per_phase = db_task_params["phase_config"].get("steps_per_phase", [2, 2, 2])
   260→            phase_config_steps = sum(steps_per_phase)
   261→
   262→            parsed_phase_config = parse_phase_config(
   263→                phase_config=db_task_params["phase_config"],
   264→                num_inference_steps=phase_config_steps,
   265→                task_id=task_id,
   266→                model_name=model,
   267→                debug_mode=debug_mode
   268→            )
   269→
   270→            generation_params["num_inference_steps"] = phase_config_steps
   271→
   272→            for key in ["guidance_phases", "switch_threshold", "switch_threshold2",
   273→                       "guidance_scale", "guidance2_scale", "guidance3_scale",
   274→                       "flow_shift", "sample_solver", "model_switch_phase",
   275→                       "lora_names", "lora_multipliers", "additional_loras"]:
   276→                if key in parsed_phase_config and parsed_phase_config[key] is not None:
   277→                    generation_params[key] = parsed_phase_config[key]
   278→
   279→            if "lora_names" in parsed_phase_config:
   280→                generation_params["activated_loras"] = parsed_phase_config["lora_names"]
   281→            if "lora_multipliers" in parsed_phase_config:
   282→                generation_params["loras_multipliers"] = " ".join(str(m) for m in parsed_phase_config["lora_multipliers"])
   283→
   284→            if "_patch_config" in parsed_phase_config:
   285→                generation_params["_parsed_phase_config"] = parsed_phase_config
   286→                generation_params["_phase_config_model_name"] = model
   287→            
   288→            # Note: LoRA URL resolution is handled centrally in HeadlessTaskQueue._convert_to_wgp_task()
   289→            # URLs in activated_loras are detected by LoRAConfig.from_params() and downloaded there
   290→        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as e:
   291→            raise ValueError(f"Task {task_id}: Invalid phase_config: {e}") from e
   292→
   293→    priority = db_task_params.get("priority", 0)
   294→    if task_type.endswith("_orchestrator"):
   295→        priority = max(priority, 10)
   296→    
   297→    generation_task = GenerationTask(
   298→        id=task_id,
   299→        model=model,
   300→        prompt=prompt,
   301→        parameters=generation_params,
   302→        priority=priority
   303→    )
   304→    
   305→    return generation_task
   306→
   307→

   120→def get_model_switch_steps(timesteps, guide_phases, model_switch_phase, switch_threshold, switch2_threshold ):
   121→    total_num_steps = len(timesteps)
   122→    model_switch_step = model_switch_step2 = None
   123→    for i, t in enumerate(timesteps):
   124→        if guide_phases >=2 and model_switch_step is None and t <= switch_threshold: model_switch_step = i
   125→        if guide_phases >=3 and model_switch_step2 is None and t <= switch2_threshold: model_switch_step2 = i                    
   126→    if model_switch_step is None: model_switch_step = total_num_steps
   127→    if model_switch_step2 is None: model_switch_step2 = total_num_steps
   128→    phases_description = ""
   129→    if guide_phases > 1:
   130→        phases_description = "Denoising Steps: "        
   131→        phases_description +=  f" Phase 1 = None" if model_switch_step == 0 else f" Phase 1 = 1:{ min(model_switch_step,total_num_steps) }"
   132→        if model_switch_step < total_num_steps:                    
   133→            phases_description += f", Phase 2 = None" if model_switch_step == model_switch_step2 else f", Phase 2 = {model_switch_step +1}:{ min(model_switch_step2,total_num_steps) }"
   134→            if guide_phases > 2 and model_switch_step2 < total_num_steps:  
   135→                phases_description += f", Phase 3 = {model_switch_step2 +1}:{ total_num_steps}"
   136→    return model_switch_step, model_switch_step2, phases_description
